equations: Eq1 pretrained target feature convolution between target layer31 and scene layer30
Eq2 salience by uniform modulation/aggregate VGG16 scene features
Eq3 clipped exponential previous-fixation memory a_tau=max(alpha^(t-tau),beta), source alpha 0.92 beta 0.5
Eq4 fixation-centered Gaussian sigma spatial map original VS1 sigma0.08 rest0.02 and max over past fixation-specific maps including overwrite on revisit

Eq5 normalized linear final attention map w_mem=-0.93 w_sac=0.2346 w_sim=1,w_sal=0 during search; reversed w_sim=0 w_sal=1 during free viewing; argmax winner-take-all, plus recognition stop only for search
new_central_native_model.world_vs_internal: External static input/target/eye tracking empirical saccade distribution is experimental World; internal source system contains inherited visual convolution plus 4 maps, finite memory/saccade update and winner-take-all; egocentric videos are external analyzed outcomes but not modeled dynamic World.

prospective_material_source_negative_con.condition: Model is direct 2018 IVSN extension; inherited 2018 code, target feature map and three visual-search human datasets must not be claimed independent invented model family
Eight original behavioral datasets are NOT eight modeled conditions; only six static-image experiments modeled; 2 egocentric-video tasks no optical flow, no 3D memory, no cooking task model
Source finite IOR is clipped exponential per fixation alpha0.92 floor beta0.5, not unbounded perfect erasure; max over all past locations including repeat overwrite
Time-constant target similarity/salience maps versus fixation-updated memory/saccade maps; full online learning is absent

Source free parameters alpha/beta/sigma and two map weights tuned on Visual Search 2 and then fixed on other five; no per-task/species fine tuning is not parameter-free or sample-independent holdout for VS2
Source original saccade prior is empirical measured dataset-specific distribution, not one universal parameters/motor mechanistic prior across all species or conditions
Feature salience removal changes next-fixation procedure to stochastic sampling; original ablation is not pure one-module deletion with fixed optimizer
Removing saccade prior has less impact on total return proportion but degrades saccade size/return offset; partial mixed per-metric original ablation results not every metric worse
Model quantitatively mismatches human return-fixation and saccade preceding return VS2/VS3 trend; no unconditional model fit or perfect species generalization
Original model has no duration of fixations or saccades, no learned task-dependent adaptation, no saccade momentum, unmodeled visual field acuity
Source visual recognition uses empirically different recognition cosine thresholds: 0.5 object-array/Waldo vs 0.3 natural images; no fully shared downstream original recognition criterion

Eight-task data include partially previously published original 2018 behavioral data and natural egocentric task; 44,328/217,440 is all source behavioral observations not computed six-model denominator
Source memoryless null still respects observed saccade amplitude and stochastic stop; do not present as total behavior-free uniform random across all image pixels
Original proof-of-principle and comparative ablations do not prove that exact finite inhibition circuit is biologically causal, uniquely necessary, or generalized stateful H2
